services.name: Gondola Cruises
services.desc: A relaxing and romantic cruise through the canals and waterways of the Coronado Cays. Duration 50 minutes Rates Pasaporto Gondola Cruise: - From $139 The Pasaporto Cruise times are all the times, day and night, that are not the designated Sunset Cruise times. Additional guests are $20 per person, up to six passengers per boat. Sunset Gondola Cruise: - From $164 for two people. The Sunset Cruise times are the peak cruise times that start as much as one and a half hours before the actual sunset and up to a half an hour after the sunset. It is possible that your cruise could end before sunset or start after the sunset. Additional guests are $20 per person, up to six passengers per boat.

services.name: Proposal Cruise
services.desc: A Venetian-Style Proposal Propose to your sweetheart in the most romantic spot in San Diego. Enjoy the tradition of Venice, Italy on a fifty-minute, relaxing, and romantic gondola cruise through the canals and waterways of the Coronado Cays. Sip on Italian prosecco and enjoy delightful chocolates from See's Candies. Snuggle up, and when the moment is right, pop the question. Our photographer will capture the moment of the proposal as well as some additional pictures of your voyage along the way. Includes a dozen red roses for your sweetheart. The photographer will edit and upload fifteen photos, which you will be able to download from their website, at no additional charge. Rates Starting
